**Limitations**

- Bright white objects and sky break the prior, so they can turn too dark or blue.
- Assumes one air light color for the whole image.
- Strengthens noise in areas of thick haze.

**Artifacts**

- Halos along strong depth edges when the guided filter radius is large.
- Too much saturation in the far parts of the scene.
